_doc: seams.json for the booth-trailer template — the vector ledger: one row per CUT (seam:true hand-offs stay out).
Kinds allowed in this template: cut-the-curve (the current, leftward) on every ordinary cut; ONE zoom-through (z+1) for the
entry into the product (title -> demo); ONE gl accent (flashWhite, cause impact) into the proof card. Nothing else: no
inverse zoom-through, no rack-focus, no waterfall, no second gl row. The seam gate measures each row on the rendered film.
cut = seconds or a cue expression: P.<phase>, P.<phase>_end, wt(<phase>,<word>[,n]), arithmetic. Phases match STORYBOARD.md.
A gl row has no exit/entry vectors: the two sides are textures and the window (dur, split before/after the cut) IS the
transition. dur 0.1-0.5 s; never between two product screens (here: footage -> recreated card).
Fictional Acme sample; the scene's layer ids follow film.example.html (#titleCard, #camera, #camera-in, #proofCard, #closeCard).
